messages.subject: CPD seminar: Recent developments in venture financing terms (5 Nov, 12:30)
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us for a lunchtime CPD session on recent trends in UK venture financing — liquidation preferences, anti-dilution mechanics and the latest BVCA model documents. Wednesday 5 November, 12:30–13:30, Training Room 2 (sandwiches provided). 1 hour CPD. RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.

WC Knowledge & Learning
